items.content: I just heard the most touching AI coding story. A friend @vicyaqingyang grew up in a modest home full of cockroaches. To turn lemons into lemonade, her mom made killing them a game. When she told this story to another friend, that friend vibe coded a game from it. You catch cockroaches in a room and compete against Mom. She cried while playing it. The game isn’t technically sophisticated. Any model can build it pretty quickly now. What gives it a soul is the human story, experience, and emotion…
